text:
Bryson (AE): hey team — kicking off the Bryson/Acme POC thread. Acme wants streaming SDK + function/tool calls + structured JSON output. blockers: KMS integration, audit logs, and a pricing estimate for a 3-week pilot. can presales help? :wave:
Jonas (Presales): yep — quick q: do they want SSE or WebSocket for ingest? SSE easier for server->client streaming, WS gives bi-directional for tool callbacks.
Tyler (Acme): we prefer bi-directional (we need callbacks to our internal task-runner). also need ephemeral creds and stricter log retention (PII filter).
Priya (SDK): ok — our JS SDK supports both. sample WS connect (node):
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/stream', {
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.POC_TOKEN}` }
});
ws.on('message', m => console.log(JSON.parse(m)));
```
Use ephemeral token endpoint: `POST /v1/tokens/ephemeral` and rotate every 5m for the POC.
Alex (Runtime): FYI for function/tool calling and low-latency callbacks we recommend: 1) pin a smaller seq-length model (e.g., 8k->4k) for interactive tests, 2) enable prefix KV caching, 3) set `batch_window_ms: 15` to balance throughput/latency. if callback latency target <250ms, reserve a small Dedicated pool.
Bryson (AE): pricing ask — can we get a short Dedicated estimate for 3-week pilot (approx 10 QPS sustained, spikes to 50)? also what's the delta for encrypted KMS at rest vs bring-your-own-key? :money_with_wings:
Maya (Acct): adding to asklist: SLA, data residency (EU), and onboarding credits.
Lena (Security): we'll need them to fill the security questionnaire. Tyler, please upload completed infosec PDF here. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK). Key wrap at rest + envelope encryption. Audit logs can be forwarded to their Syslog/S3 endpoint.
sec-bot: security-questionnaire-template v2 uploaded — https://redwood.internal/sq/templates/presales-poc-v2.pdf :lock:
Tyler (Acme): got it. we have SOC2 and can share SSO/SAML details. one more: structured output schema — we need deterministic JSON only (no free text). can function calls return typed JSON to our webhook?
Jonas (Presales): yes — use `structured_output_schema` in the request; SDK will validate and `function_call` events will include typed payload. sample request payload:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-compact",
  "stream": true,
  "structured_output_schema": { "type":"object","properties":{"taskId":{"type":"string"},"action":{"type":"string"}} ,"required":["taskId","action"] }
}
```
Priya (SDK): tooling note — our SDK will emit `tool_call` events as a JSON block: `{ "tool": "run_task", "args": {...} }` and you can wire that to your internal runner. we can show a small demo.
Alex (Runtime): Ops/eng note — if you plan to call internal APIs from tool calls, we recommend pre-authorized ephemeral service tokens scoped to that callback only. avoid embedding long-lived secrets in the model layer.
Bryson (AE): blockers tracker: (1) Acme to return SQ + SSO details, (2) Redwood to provide Dedicated 3-week cost + sample contract addendum, (3) demo call to validate structured tool callback.
Maya (Acct): I'll compile costs — expect an estimate by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (SDK): can do a 30-min screenshare demo Wednesday 10am PT. I'll show WS handshake, ephemeral token flow, and function_call plumbing.
Tyler (Acme): Wednesday 10am PT works. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Jonas (Presales): I'll prepare a mini-runbook with the WS handshake, token refresh, and sample PII-filter config. dropping it here after the demo. :eyes:
Bryson (AE): perfect — tagging @Lena and @Maya for legal/security follow-ups. thanks all.
